provenance_exempt: prospective command partition; contains no simulation measurement

source_target_requirements.representative_trace_role: qualitative or secondary single-cell shape evidence only

primary_source_figure_map.kv3_deactivation: Ding, Matta, Zhou 2011 Figure 9 (representative tails and population time-constant curve)
